title: Bug
body:
Hi Brain.fm! I think I’ve found a bug with the Neural Effect setting. I have High Neural Effect selected, but in some modes the music still plays with Low Neural Effect. Other modes work correctly and play with High as selected.

So the issue only seems to affect certain modes. Could you please look into why some modes switch to Low even though High is selected?
author: JorgenMaster66

title: Really helpful!
body: I use Brain.fm when I need to sit down and work on something that requires focus. It helps me get into a focused state and block out noise from my head and surroundings. I think part of what makes it work is that the music is rhythmic with steady, predictable beats, that the soundscape is often a bit simple, and that the tracks are long enough for my head to get used to the sound and place it in the background.
author: TheodorJS

title: Good
body: Helps me control hyperfocus better with my ADHD. Keep my mind from finding distractions in my environment

author: HerlofHerlofsen

title: En av mine beste life-hacks
body:
Har adhd, og når det er en oppgave jeg bare ikke klarer å begynne på, så er det vanligvis bare å ha den foran meg og sette på brain.fm på "Intense focus".

Har brukt brain.fm i mange år, men begynte først nå å bruke appen. Og den er helt super! 

Anbefales på det aller sterkeste. Ikke la deg narre til å tro at det bare er å sette på noen binaural beats på Youtube for å oppnå det samme. Dette er heftige greier.

author: matsegu

title: It works, but I would like a bit more variation
body: I use Brain.fm for work almost every day. It simply works. However, I find the focusing soundtracks a bit too similar and would like to see a bit more variation. I haven’t read all the research behind the product so what I am asking might not be possible, but still. Sleep-mode does not work for me, but relax-mode does work. I recommend this to anyone working with attention and focus-demanding tasks.
